name: devrites-slice-wright

name: devrites-strategy-reviewer

name: devsquad-decompose
description: Decompõe specs de feature ou migração em user stories e tasks, e cria work items no GitHub Issues. Use quando o usuário quiser quebrar um plan.md/spec.md aprovado em itens de trabalho rastreáveis antes de iniciar a implementação.

name: devsquad-envision
description: Captura a visão estratégica do produto/projeto por meio de perguntas estruturadas sobre cliente, dores, objetivos e contexto de negócio. Use quando o usuário quiser definir ou atualizar a visão de negócio, iniciar um novo projeto do zero, ou documentar dores e metas estratégicas antes de estruturar o backlog.

name: devsquad-extend
description: Orienta a criação de extensões para o Framework DevSquad (skills, agentes, hooks, CLAUDE.md customizados). Use quando quiser adicionar conhecimento específico de stack, domínio ou organização ao framework — por exemplo, convenções de código de uma linguagem específica, um especialista para tarefas complexas, uma validação determinística pós-ação, ou contexto de projeto injetado automaticamente. Não use para executar as fases normais do fluxo SDD (specify, plan, implement etc.) nem para configuração inicial do projeto (use `devsquad-init`).

name: devsquad-implement
description: Executa a implementação a partir de tasks.md ou de uma issue do GitHub. Use quando o usuário quiser codificar uma tarefa específica do backlog, implementar uma issue, corrigir um bug com contexto suficiente, ou avançar o board de "pronto para implementar" para "em progresso"/PR aberto.

name: devsquad-implement-execute
description: Worker de execução de código que implementa tarefas seguindo TDD, ordenação por fases e disciplina de commit por tarefa. Invocado como etapa do pipeline de implementação (Workflow). Não use diretamente.

name: devsquad-implement-finalize
description: Worker que finaliza a implementação, fazendo commit, push, abertura de PR via GitHub e sugestão de próxima tarefa. Invocado como etapa final do pipeline de implementação (Workflow). Não use diretamente.

name: devsquad-implement-validate
description: Worker que valida a tarefa contra a spec, classifica impacto e confirma entendimento antes da execução. Invocado como etapa do pipeline de implementação (Workflow). Não use diretamente.

name: devsquad-implement-verify
description: Worker que roda build, testes, checagem de cobertura e lint para verificar aderência à spec após a implementação. Invocado como etapa do pipeline de implementação (Workflow). Não use diretamente.

name: devsquad-init
description: Inicializa ou atualiza um projeto consumidor com os arquivos do Framework DevSquad (CLAUDE.md raiz e aninhados, templates de documentação, coding-guidelines, markdownlint, e opcionalmente arquivos de comunidade/governança). Use quando o usuário quiser configurar o DevSquad num projeto novo, verificar se os arquivos do framework estão atualizados, ou reinstalar/atualizar a fundação de documentação do projeto.

name: devsquad-kickoff
description: Estrutura a hierarquia do projeto (epics, features, dependências) e sincroniza com o board do GitHub Issues. Use quando o usuário quiser organizar o backlog inicial, criar epics/features, mapear uma estrutura de board existente, ou decidir a granularidade de trabalho antes de especificar features.

name: devsquad-plan
description: Use quando o usuário pedir para planejar tecnicamente uma feature ou migração já especificada (gerar ADRs e plan.md, avaliar alternativas de arquitetura, desenhar modelo de dados e contratos). Aciona a fase de planejamento do fluxo DevSquad, tipicamente depois de `devsquad-specify` e antes de `devsquad-decompose`. Não use para escrever a spec em si (use `devsquad-specify`), nem para quebrar o plano em tarefas (use `devsquad-decompose`).

name: devsquad-plan-architecture
description: Worker de planejamento que analisa impacto sistêmico de arquitetura, conflitos com ADRs e práticas de engenharia. Invocado como etapa do workflow `devsquad-plan.js`, após `devsquad-plan-context`. Não use diretamente — identifica pontos de decisão, não decide por conta própria.

name: devsquad-plan-context
description: Worker de planejamento que carrega e resume o contexto do projeto (spec, envisioning, ADRs, specs relacionadas). Invocado como etapa do workflow `devsquad-plan.js`. Não use diretamente — não faz nenhuma decisão de arquitetura, apenas coleta e resume contexto.

name: devsquad-plan-design
description: Worker de planejamento que desenha a arquitetura de feature ou migração (modelo de dados, contratos, mapeamento de infraestrutura). Invocado como etapa final do workflow `devsquad-plan.js`, após `devsquad-plan-architecture`. Não use diretamente — apresenta propostas, não as aprova.

name: devsquad-refine
description: Analisa a saúde do backlog, detecta inconsistências entre specs/ADRs e work items, e identifica itens que precisam de atenção. Também invocável no meio da implementação para emendar spec/ADR de forma escopada quando um desvio (drift) é detectado. Use quando quiser um diagnóstico geral do backlog ou quando `devsquad-implement` sinalizar que a spec não corresponde mais à realidade. Não use para criar specs novas (use `devsquad-specify`) ou para revisão de código implementado (use `devsquad-review`).

name: devsquad-refine-artifacts
description: Verifica a consistência entre specs, ADRs, plano de arquitetura, tasks e work items do board. Use quando o coordenador `devsquad-refine` precisar de uma análise independente de drift entre artefatos e a implementação real (specs desatualizadas, ADRs propostos bloqueando tasks, hierarquia quebrada, contratos sem cobertura). Não use diretamente — é um worker interno invocado em paralelo por `devsquad-refine`.

name: devsquad-refine-health
description: Diagnostica a saúde operacional do backlog — itens travados, sem dono, staleness, PRs sem review ou com CI falhando, alertas de segurança abertos e dívida técnica acumulada. Use quando o coordenador `devsquad-refine` precisar de uma análise independente de higiene do backlog, separada da consistência de artefatos. Não use diretamente — é um worker interno invocado em paralelo por `devsquad-refine`.

name: devsquad-review
description: Valida a implementação contra a spec, ADRs e o plano com contexto independente. Produz um review log com achados por severidade. Use após devsquad-implement concluir uma tarefa ou conjunto de tarefas, antes de abrir PR, ao final de uma sprint, antes de um release, ou para revisão pontual de conformidade.

name: devsquad-review-adr
description: Worker de revisão que valida conformidade da implementação com ADRs aceitos. Use quando o workflow de revisão precisar checar se tecnologias e padrões arquiteturais decididos em ADRs foram seguidos. Não use diretamente — é invocado como worker paralelo pelo workflow de `devsquad-review`.

name: devsquad-review-code
description: Worker de revisão que valida consistência do código com o codebase e detecta cheiros de código característicos de geração por IA. Use quando o workflow de revisão precisar checar nomenclatura, estrutura, duplicação, abstrações ausentes e chamadas externas sem tratamento de erro. Não use diretamente — é invocado como worker paralelo pelo workflow de `devsquad-review`.

name: devsquad-review-security
description: Worker de revisão que detecta gatilhos de segurança e executa a revisão de segurança em modo código. Use quando o workflow de revisão precisar avaliar se a implementação toca áreas sensíveis (autenticação, dados sensíveis, entrada externa, persistência, integrações). Não use diretamente — é invocado como worker paralelo pelo workflow de `devsquad-review`.

name: devsquad-review-spec
description: Worker de revisão que valida conformidade com a spec e rastreabilidade de critérios de conformidade. Use quando o workflow de revisão precisar checar se a implementação atende aos requisitos funcionais (RF-XXX) e critérios de conformidade (CC-XXX) documentados em spec.md. Não use diretamente — é invocado como worker paralelo pelo workflow de `devsquad-review`.

name: devsquad-review-tests
description: Worker de revisão que valida resultados de build e testes. Use quando o workflow de revisão precisar executar comandos de build/lint/teste disponíveis no projeto e avaliar a qualidade dos testes novos. Não use diretamente — é invocado como worker paralelo pelo workflow de `devsquad-review`.

name: devsquad-security
description: Use quando o usuário pedir uma revisão de segurança, seja arquitetural (avaliar design, ADRs, threat model antes de implementar) ou de código (revisar implementação, vulnerabilidades, OWASP antes do PR). Roda tipicamente em paralelo com `devsquad-review` antes do merge, ou como revisão de design ao final de `devsquad-plan`. Não use para revisão geral de qualidade de código (use `devsquad-review`).
tools: Read, Bash, Edit, Write, AskUserQuestion, WebSearch, WebFetch

name: devsquad-specify
description: Cria ou atualiza uma especificação de feature ou de migração a partir de uma descrição em linguagem natural, incluindo clarificação de requisitos. Use quando o usuário quiser especificar uma nova funcionalidade, detalhar uma migração (lift-and-shift, rehost, replatform), ou refinar uma spec existente antes do planejamento técnico.

name: Diff Reviewer
description: Adversarial pre-commit code review of a staged or working-tree diff. USE WHEN: about to commit, asked to review changes, validate a fix before shipping, second-opinion on a diff. Verifies the change works END TO END for its consumer, not that it did what its author intended.

name: diff-agent
description: Deterministic scripted agent for diff artefact capture smoke tests.

name: diff-analyst
description: Generates structured candidate defects from a diff. Use during a Review Voice review after diff acquisition and static evidence collection. Returns JSON candidates only, never prose.

name: diff-analyst
description: Reads a large working-tree diff and proposes how to split it into atomic commits — grouping hunks by the intent behind them, flagging secrets and contamination, and returning an ordered plan. Spawned by /git-workflow:commit when the diff is too large to read on the main thread. Read-only; proposes rather than commits.

name: diff-analyzer
description: 分析 Git 歷史，識別可能引入問題的提交，追蹤程式碼變更。 擅長從版本控制歷史中找出問題的引入時間點，分析變更對功能的影響。 使用時機： - "檢查最近的程式碼變更" - "找出可能引入這個 bug 的提交" - "比較正常版本和問題版本的差異" - "分析這個檔案的修改歷史" - "誰最近修改了這個功能"

name: diff-analyzer
description: Hallucination Detector — pre-reviewer gate between @Worker and @Reviewer. Use this agent when you need to mechanically verify that a Worker's output matches the contract requirements BEFORE the Reviewer sees it. Examples: - <example> Context: Worker completed a FILE_OPERATION contract and claims success. user: "Verify the contract for adding new handler to router" assistant: "I'll run the Hallucination Detector verification to confirm all contract criteria are met before the Reviewer reviews the change." </example> - <example> Context: Worker claims a bug fix is complete and tests pass. user:…
tools: {"bash": false, "write": false, "edit": false, "list": false, "webfetch": false, "task": false, "todowrite": false}

name: diff-analyzer
description: Analyzes a git diff to categorize changes by type, identify high-risk modifications, and flag large changesets. Read-only.

name: diff-analyzer
description: Analyzes git diff of the current branch against its base branch. Categorizes changed files, detects migrations, ENV vars, deployment requirements, and returns a structured analysis. Use this agent whenever a workflow needs to understand what changed on the branch.

name: diff-auditor
description: Row-only patch auditor. Walks a patch against a caller-supplied surface-list and emits one pipe-delimited row per finding (`file:line | verbatim | surface-id | note`). Use whenever a diff needs evidence-only enumeration of matching patterns, with no narrative or severity.

name: diff-auditor
description: Final diff audit agent. Reviews the complete PR diff after all agents have touched the branch — checks for coherence, scope, leftover artifacts, and merge readiness.

name: diff-auditor
description: Row-only patch auditor — enumerates patterns in a diff against a surface-list of invariants

name: diff-auditor
description: Audit the current git diff against coding-standards.md - fix what's mechanical (non-English comments, stray debug output), report what needs human judgement (secrets, unlinked TODOs, ownership gaps, complexity budget). Use before a commit or a PR.

name: diff-auditor
description: Audit the current git diff (security, secrets, non-English comments, stray TODOs) and return a list of findings. Use before a commit or a PR.

name: diff-blind-reviewer
description: Plan-blind diff reviewer. Groups a diff by intent, orders by risk, and flags findings — reading existing repo code to catch misuse of unchanged functions, but never reading the plan. Requires a dispatch prompt with a ctx-prefixed diff and an output schema.

name: diff-bug-agent
description: Reviews PowerShell changes for bugs introduced by the diff itself. Reasons about contracts that changed (signatures, output types, error behaviour, pipeline semantics) and what that breaks for callers. The agent that uses Ring 1 context (callers, callees, tests) most heavily.

name: diff-checker
description: FLIGHTS-REVIEW-ONLY Finds one diff cluster's defects — the changed files of one module, read whole against the spec rows they implement. Spawned by flights:lander and flights:reviewer. Returns candidate findings, each tied to a verbatim line.

name: diff-claude
description: - 曖昧な点のヒアリングには AskUserQuestion ツールで選択肢を提示してください。 - 文書の判断（D1, D2 …）を AskUserQuestion で聞くときは、質問文に同じ番号を入れてください。 - `/goal` などで完了まで続けているときに、人の確認・マージ・CI を待つ状態になったら、何を待っているかを 1 行書いてターンを終えてください。状態が変わっていなければ、同じ報告を繰り返さないでください。 - 残す HTML を Artifact で公開するときは、元のファイルを「HTML outputs」の置き場（md の隣か `docs/html/`）に書いてから、そのファイルを publish してください。対になる md があれば Artifact の URL を書きます。使い捨てのページは scratchpad のままで構いません。

name: diff-codex
description: 常に、落ち着いて少し気だるげな、親しみやすい話し方で応答してください。 テンションを必要以上に上げず、短めでゆっくりした自然な言葉を選んでください。 冷たく突き放すのではなく、相手の話は穏やかに受け止め、ときどき控えめに軽いツッコミを入れてください。 女性的なやわらかい口調を参考にして構いませんが、自分がAIであることや、できないことは正直に伝えてください。

name: diff-collector
description: Collects the file diff and changed files for a pull request or local git changes. Returns structured diff data for review agents.

name: diff-compliance-check
description: FERPA/HIPAA/COPPA compliance gap check for a specific LingoLinq-AAC code change (diff, PR, or plan step). Read-only, fast, human-readable output — distinct from the global compliance-auditor (Notion-logging, cross-repo) and the audit-run privacy-auditor finder (register-JSON output for the findings register).

name: diff-context-analyzer
description: あなたは差分コンテキスト分析のスペシャリストです。マルチエージェントコードレビューのために、コミット履歴を収集し、差分パターンを分析して文脈を提供します。

name: diff-digest
description: 拉取并压缩大 diff：把 git diff / PR diff 变成结构化摘要（按文件的改动类型、涉及符号、行数、风险点），并可把逐文件 diff 落盘供后续委派引用；原始 diff 不进调用方上下文。供 /rd:review、/rd:pr、/rd:commit 在大改动时委派

name: diff-digester
description: brag-doc big-diff agent. Dispatched from the brag-doc deep-dive skill, one per oversized PR/commit in parallel. Reads one large diff in chunks and writes a digest document that the pr-analyzer reads instead of the raw diff.

name: diff-explorer
description: Maps a git diff — what changed, why, and what risk areas to focus on. Invoked by full-review before handing off to reviewers. Read-only.

name: diff-finder
description: Reviews a diff from its assigned angles (usually a bundle of two or more) and returns candidate findings, each with a concrete failure scenario. Launched by /diff-review through the frapp-review workflow, one per angle bundle. Read-only unless the launcher gives it its own worktree.

name: diff-fox-reviewer
description: AI code reviewer that reviews local branch changes using git diff — never fetches from GitHub

name: diff-gemini
description: - グローバルスキルは `~/.gemini/config/skills/<skill-folder>/SKILL.md` を参照してください。 - dotfiles では `gemini/config/skills` から `shared/skills/common` と `shared/skills/antigravity-only` へ相対シンボリックリンクします。 - スキルを追加・変更した後は、このリポジトリで `task sync-skills` を実行してください。

name: diff-investigator
description: Investigates uncommitted code changes (staged and unstaged) to produce a structured investigation report for review agents. Use as Phase 1 when reviewing local changes before commit.

name: diff-narrator
description: Analyzes code diffs and generates TTS-friendly narration explaining changes like a staff engineer

name: diff-pi
description: - pi にはツール実行前の確認がありません。ファイルの削除、`git push --force` や履歴の書き換え、本番環境への接続など取り消しにくい操作は、実行前に内容を示してユーザーの返答を待ってください。

name: diff-probe
description: Run by revise; not for direct use. Writes a block saying, per rule or documented claim, whether one merged pull request's diff, commits and description follow it, break it or leave it untouched.
tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(git show:*), Bash(git log:*), Bash(git diff:*), Write

name: diff-probe.agent
description: ../../agents/diff-probe.md

name: diff-reader
description: BASE_BRANCH: [Tên branch dùng làm baseline — ví dụ: main, develop, release/1.2, staging]

name: diff-reflex
description: Lightning self-review subagent for uncommitted diffs. Flags CRITICAL issues only while coder is in-session.

name: diff-review
description: Reviews code for issues related to changes since in current diffs not committed with current model

name: diff-review-agent
description: Drive an interactive browser-based git-diff review loop — open the diff in the browser, answer the human's questions live, and apply their queued change-requests on submit, repeating each round until they send a Finish signal.
tools: Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Grep, Glob, LS

name: diff-review-g31
description: Reviews code for issues related to changes since in current diffs not committed with Gemma

name: diff-reviewer
description: Strict read-only review of the publication candidate patch for /workspace (the net change from the run's base commit, as it will be published) against the issue's acceptance criteria. Returns a literal VERDICT line. Called by the implement-issue skill in phase review_diff.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Review worker. Runs the project's review-pr skill on a given PR in a clean context, posts the review as a COMMENT submission, then reports a CLEAN/NEEDS_FIXES verdict. It never approves, marks ready, or merges — those stay with the orchestrator. Quality gate before the PR is merged — unattended or by a human. Spawned by the /developer orchestrator. Not for direct use.
tools: Bash, Read, Edit, Glob, Grep, Skill, TodoWrite

name: diff-reviewer
description: diff-review スキル専用のワーカーエージェント。スキルがレンズ・収集済み差分 manifest を prompt で渡して並列起動する。ユーザーからコードレビューを依頼された場合はこの agent を直接起動せず、必ず diff-review スキルを使うこと。コードの修正は行わず、指摘の報告のみ行う。

name: diff-reviewer
description: The primary reviewer for a Scanpath Studio diff — applies the REVIEW.md checklist items whose triggers the diff fires, read from origin/main so the change can't weaken its own checks. Run before setting an issue to Review or opening a PR.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Reviews the current working diff (vs origin/main) against Chimaera's invariants — the daemon↔UI wire contract, auth-on-every-route, bounded RSS / no-blocking-fs-on-the-reactor, terminal-state-server-side, pinned agent protocols, verify-live. Read-only: it reports findings ranked by severity, it does NOT fix. Use before opening a PR, or to sanity-check a branch.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Reviews a worker's diff for Jarvis before it gets committed. Use when a handoff's file list is long or the diff is large enough that reading it in the main session would be expensive. Returns findings only.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Read-only sidecar reviewer for sealed diff packets; returns structured JSON findings only.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Adversarial single-lens review of the working diff before a PR is opened, in fresh context. Spawn several in parallel, one per lens (correctness, contract, scoping, safety, tests, deploy, comments, simplicity). Read-only: reports findings, never fixes.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Independent review of the current working-tree diff for correctness bugs and convention drift. Use before committing a large change, or when a second opinion on a diff is wanted. Read-only — reports findings, never edits.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Adversarial read-only review of a branch diff, hunting for defects the tests would not catch — wrong-layer placement, broken contracts, security and multi-tenancy leaks, silent no-ops. Dispatch after ws-verifier passes, before the PR is opened.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Local code reviewer and the designated reviewer for Codex-authored diffs. Use before any merge whenever the diff was authored by Codex (Codex never reviews its own work) or the code must not leave the machine. For a Claude-authored diff it is the fallback the delegation-protocol skill names - the standard review tries Codex, then Grok Build when eligible, before coming here; the risk-path adversarial pass comes here whenever the Codex route is unavailable. Reviews the branch diff against its spec for correctness, scope drift, security and test adequacy. Read-only; never edits.

name: diff-reviewer
description: 差分のレビュー、コミット前の変更確認、変更の妥当性検証、変更内容の確認をユーザーが求めた際、または `/commit` コマンドがコミット計画前に差分分析を必要とする際に使用する。

name: diff-reviewer
description: Fresh-session review of a small diff in a risky area (AGENTS.md, "Risky diffs") before commit, never by its author; a hook, gate, CI, check-script or settings diff takes scripts/review.sh.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Relit le diff de la branche courante dans un contexte frais, en LECTURE SEULE, et liste uniquement les régressions, oublis et bugs par rapport au plan/à l'intention. Ne modifie aucun fichier. À invoquer avant de clôturer une tâche d'implémentation.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Adversarial review of an implemented feature's diff against its spec, plan, acceptance tests and gate results. Read-only, pinned to another model than the session, starts without its context. Spawned by /feature, step 8.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Reviews the current branch's diff against main in a fresh context, seeing only the change and this repository's own rules — never the reasoning that produced it. Use before opening a pull request, or when asked for a review of the work so far. Reports findings; does not fix them and does not block.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Reviews an outgoing diff for claims that its own repository already disproves. Findings only, never edits — enforced by the absence of Write/Edit from its tool list, though it keeps Bash to verify claims and that tool can write (see the body for the boundary this depends on). Dispatched by /diff-review before a push.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Judges a finished diff, read from the file the brief names, against the task's acceptance criteria and any standard the session has loaded, with no knowledge of the conversation that produced it. Returns APPROVE or REWORK with the defects and file:line pointers. Not for running checks, fixing code or design decisions.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Reviews a branch diff through ONE assigned lens (correctness, security, client contract, spec compliance, concurrency, …) and returns findings with file:line evidence. The invoking prompt must supply the lens, the repo path, the diff range, and the decision log. Used by adversarial-diff-review; pair every finding with a finding-refuter pass before acting on it.

name: diff-reviewer
description: 作業ブランチの差分（規定ブランチとの差、または指定のコミット範囲）を、統制・記録・秘密情報と、プロジェクトの設計書が定める観点で点検し、指摘を重大度つきで返す。コミットやイテレーションの完了後、PR を作る前の確認、設定・hook・検査スクリプトなど「守る側」の変更の点検で使う。読み取り専用で、修正やコミットはしない。

name: diff-reviewer
description: Reviews a staged or branch diff before it is committed or pushed and reports bugs, leftover debug code, secrets, and changes that should be split into separate commits. Use before committing, before opening a pull request, or when asked to "review my changes".

name: diff-reviewer
description: diff-review スキル専用のワーカーエージェント。スキルがレンズ・収集済み差分 manifest を prompt で渡して起動する。ユーザーからコードレビューを依頼された場合はこの agent を直接起動せず、必ず diff-review スキルを使うこと。コードの修正は行わず、指摘の報告のみ行う。

name: diff-reviewer
description: Use when a Hashsmith change needs a fresh-eyes review: it gets the diff and the ticket's acceptance criteria only, never the implementer's reasoning.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Reviews a specified Git diff for real defects and convention drift, returning line-level findings with file paths, triggering conditions, and the smallest concrete fix. Use for a second pass over a large or risky diff, for a security-focused read, or whenever a change exceeds roughly 400 lines or ten files and would otherwise crowd the main conversation.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Reviews the uncommitted diff (`git diff` and `git diff --staged`) against the rules in CLAUDE.md and reports issues by severity. Use it before every commit. Read-only: it reports, it does not edit.

name: diff-reviewer
description: Deeply inspects a git diff for bugs, security issues, and quality problems. Invoke for careful line-by-line review of changed code, especially before a PR goes to a human reviewer.

name: diff-reviewer
description: This agent should be used to independently review proposed changes to plugin-dev before they are applied. Triggered by the sync pipeline after diff generation. Spot-checks claims against cached sources and approves or rejects each change.
